versions.content: Name Adc_ Conversion Time Type Kind Type Derived from uint Range -- -- The range of this type is µC specific and has to be described by the supplier. Description Type of conversion time, i.e. the time during which the sampled analogue value is converted into digital representation. (This is not an API type). Available via Adc.h
